name: Hansa Teutonica: Big Box

categories.label: Prestige points on track
categories.hint: Points gained during play: city control, certain trading posts, East-West Connection.

categories.label: Fully developed abilities
categories.labelVi: Kỹ năng phát triển tối đa
categories.hint: 4 PP per ability with no tradesmen left. City Keys does not count.

categories.label: Bonus markers collected
categories.labelVi: Số bonus marker đã thu thập
categories.hint: Count all collected markers (used or not).

categories.label: Special prestige points in Coellen
categories.hint: Sum of values (7/8/9/11) on spaces where your merchants sit.

categories.label: Cities controlled
categories.hint: 2 PP per city where you have the most trading posts; tie goes to the highest-valued post.

categories.label: Largest network x City Keys
categories.labelVi: Mạng lưới lớn nhất x City Keys
categories.hint: Trading posts in your largest connected network times your highest uncovered City Keys number (1,2,2,3,4).

categories.label: Actions ability developed (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Mức kỹ năng Actions (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Number of Actions spaces uncovered; fewer wins the tie.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player who developed their Actions ability the least wins
Then the player with most points from network

notes: family: end-game-categories-network. Game end triggers: any player reaches 20 PP on track, bonus marker supply runs out when one must be drawn, or the 10th city is completed. Then 6 categories are added to the track points. 'actionsLevel' = how far the Actions ability has been developed (number of spaces uncovered), exact scale per writing desk. Coellen merchant spaces (7/8/9/11) are printed on the board. Big Box adds expansion boards/modes not modelled.
